desc: The ATN THOR 5 LRF (Long Range Fusion) is a cutting-edge thermal riflescope specifically designed for long-range shooting and observation. It combines advanced thermal imaging technology with laser rangefinding capabilities, providing shooters with exceptional performance and accuracy in various conditions. The THOR 5 LRF utilizes a high-resolution thermal sensor that detects the heat signatures emitted by objects, ensuring clear and detailed imaging even in complete darkness or adverse weather conditions such as fog or smoke. With its thermal imaging capability, this riflescope allows users to see through obstacles and identify targets that are otherwise hidden to the naked eye.
